fields.description: What the company owes customers in unspent cashback. Earned cashback is credited here and spent cashback is debited. Leave empty to create "Cashback" under Current Liabilities.
fields.label: Cashback Liability Account

fields.description: The cost of the cashback program. Earned cashback is debited here, and expired or returned cashback is credited back. Leave empty to create "Cashback Expense" under Indirect Expenses.
fields.label: Cashback Expense Account

fields.description: Liability account this company holds customer deposits in. Blank = LumenPOS creates 'Customer Deposits'.
fields.label: Customer deposits account
Due from group companies
fields.description: Asset account for what other companies of the group owe this one for customer balances spent here. Created automatically when empty.

fields.label: Due to group companies
fields.description: Liability account for what this company owes others of the group for its customer balances spent there. Created automatically when empty.
